newsitem.title: USA: Oryx sees Q4 shr loss of $0.21 to $0.24.
newsitem.headline: Oryx sees Q4 shr loss of $0.21 to $0.24.

text.p: Oryx Technology Corp said Friday that it is estimating a net loss for the quarter ended February 28 at between $2.5 million and $2.9 million, or between $0.21 and $0.24 per share, respectively, on sales of approximately $6.0 million.
This loss, said the company, includes a non-cash charge of $0.7 million associated with the acquisition of the assets of Power Sensors, Inc.
Net loss in the year-earlier period was $0.4 million, or $0.07 per share, on sales of $4.6 million, including an extraordinary gain on debt restructuring of $1.4 million.

As a result of the fiscal year 1997 fourth quarter losses, Oryx said it will report a net loss for the 1997 fiscal year estimated to be between $1.8 million and $2.2 million, or between $0.17 and $0.21 per share respectively, on sales of approximately $27.0 million, compared to a net loss of $2.8 million, or $0.48 per share on revenues of $16.1 million in fiscal year 1996.

The company said its fourth quarter results were also impacted by the significant reduction in business from the its largest customer, delay in shipments to customers of test equipment, and higher research and development costs.
